formula.visual: Median same-state RGB MAE, capped at 10%, shrunk toward 50% loss until 12 accepted pairs exist.
formula.comparability: Pairs require normalized state names, matching aspect ratio within 1.5%, and MAE <= 25%; rejected pairs remain in the ledger.
formula.scope: Cumulative unique work stories divided by the final known 379-story scope; continuous frames count as one story.
formula.completeness: Observed Web/Lynx/Native cells divided by expected cells for discovered stories.
formula.reliability: Active, commit-bounded regression severity points divided by the ledger maximum.
